newsitem.title: PANAMA: Taiwan and Panama in agreement to boost trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan and Panama in agreement to boost trade.

text.p: Taiwan and Panama signed on Friday a convention aimed at boosting bilateral trade, Taiwan's Economics Minister Wang Chih-kang said.
He told Reuters the agreement would "help upgrade standards in industry and especially exchange information on small to medium-sized industries."
The deal signed with Panama's Industry and Commerce Minister Raul Arango Gasteazoro will help Panamanian companies receive Taiwanese expertise in management, production and marketing.

Panama is one of the few nations with formal diplomatic links with Taiwan, which is an important investor in Panama. Shipping giant Evergreen Marine Corp (Taiwan) Ltd has spent $200 million on a new port facility and has set up a branch of its EVA Airways unit.

The Taiwanese government has also contributed $800,000 to help organize an international conference on the future of the Panama canal next month. President Lee Teng-hui has said he will attend the conference.
(( -- Paul de Bendern, Panama City newsroom, 507-223 7739))
